China's visa curbs impact travel and talent flow

China has implemented new travel restrictions, leading to visa rejections that are making festival-season travel to the country difficult. These curbs are also unsettling tech firms and workers by preventing key talent from leaving China. The measures are reportedly impacting holiday plans and raising concerns among businesses.
